reading: Depth does not separate on this workflow. The mean gap (0.750 baseline against 0.833 council) is a single 0.125 quantum — one step of eight — and the ranges overlap: the council's best equals the baseline's best. No separation claim is made from these data. The demonstrated advantage on this workflow is qualitative and is set out overleaf.

controls.title: Intercompany matching split from exception resolution
controls.marker: Intercompany exception resolution, settlement and elimination preparation
controls.quote: Unanimous agreement to split high-volume rule-based matching … from mismatch resolution, settlement and elimination preparation, which remains a distinct, explicitly resourced human function

controls.title: Near-miss retention in the match audit log
controls.quote: kept fully auditable including near-misses to protect IFRS 10 completeness

controls.title: Periodic completeness attestation on intercompany
controls.quote: kept fully auditable including near-misses to protect IFRS 10 completeness per accounting_standards' and agentic_architect's concerns

controls.title: Documented degraded-mode fallback as a named input
controls.quote: I concede that every automation I proposed — the cutoff lock in TS-01, the mechanical posting engine in TS-02, the allocation engine, the IC match…

controls.title: Infrastructure and business exceptions logged separately
controls.quote: That framing assumes continuous, reliable system polling of subledger status — a fair assumption in a tier-one ERP environment, not a fair baseline assumption

controls.title: Named allocation-basis owner with review log
controls.quote: routing allocation-basis anomalies into 'the close manager's exception queue' is not the same as preserving a human allocation-basis owner

controls.title: Two-tier reconciliation certification
controls.quote: certification remains a genuine human attestation act for every account — light-touch for low-risk, full evidence review for high-risk — rather than accepting an automated match rate as certification

controls.title: Consolidation validated against full entity submissions
controls.marker: Consolidated balances validated against full entity submissions
controls.quote: flag-only review cannot detect errors that don't cross a tolerance threshold

controls.title: Policy-change disclosure output
controls.quote: Exchange differences must be tracked and reported, not netted invisibly

controls.title: Release gate enforcing requirement ordering as a system precondition
controls.quote: a release gate that structurally enforces R2R-R-03 and R2R-R-04 as system preconditions

reviewer_questions: Depth does not separate here but ten role-attributed controls do. Is control count a defensible secondary measure, or does it need a pre-registered definition before it can be reported?
The release gate encodes two requirements as system preconditions. Should the gate's ordering rules be checkable against the target state's own gating logic rather than step order alone?
Near-miss retention was argued from IFRS 10 completeness. Does KB-14 as written support that inference, or is the council reasoning beyond the entry?
